title: Compat API v1.50: DELETE /images platforms support, Fixes: #30163
body:
Support the `platforms` query parameter in the Compat `DELETE /images/{name}` endpoint for Docker Engine API v1.50.

- Decode the `platforms` query parameter in `pkg/api/handlers/compat/images_remove.go` and pass it through `entities.ImageRemoveOptions`.
- Update `ImageEngine.Remove` in `pkg/domain/infra/abi/images.go` to check platform matches for single images and remove matching platform instances (along with associated descriptors and child images) from manifest lists.
- Add unit and APIv2 tests covering platform-specific image removal.

Fixes: #30163
Refs: #30159
